description_exact: Possible SQL injection UNION SELECT in HTTP URI
conditions: alert http any any -> any any (msg:"Possible SQL injection UNION SELECT in HTTP URI"; flow:established,to_server; http.uri; content:"union"; nocase; fast_pattern; pcre:"/\bunion(?:\s|\+)+(?:all(?:\s|\+)+|distinct(?:\s|\+)+)?select\b/i"; classtype:web-application-attack; sid:9900101; rev:1;)
interpretation: HTTP established to_server; UNION [ALL|DISTINCT] SELECT trong normalized URI, nhận space hoặc dấu+ theo PCRE. Không bao quát mọi encoding/evasion/SQL dialect.

description_exact: Possible SQL injection UNION SELECT in HTTP request body
conditions: alert http any any -> any any (msg:"Possible SQL injection UNION SELECT in HTTP request body"; flow:established,to_server; http.request_body; url_decode; content:"union"; nocase; fast_pattern; pcre:"/\bunion\s+(?:all\s+|distinct\s+)?select\b/i"; classtype:web-application-attack; sid:9900102; rev:1;)
interpretation: http.request_body + url_decode; mẫu UNION SELECT sau decode. Chỉ quan sát body trong giới hạn engine/config; HTTPS mã hóa không tự giải mã.
